title: Farfarout Demo
author: MorophonBoundless
selftext:
Hi there,

I am just dropping this here, maybe you'll get a kick out of it ! [https://supercitron.itch.io/farfarout-demo](https://supercitron.itch.io/farfarout-demo)

1:1 Solar system recreation  
Newtonian physics  
Seamless planet landings

Coffee ???

... and more to discover :)

  
I just had to get it out there and get some feedback, I am not a gamedev (though I work in IT), I just wanted to be able to cruise the solar system at my own pace.

Didn't write a single line of code but I did steer the project end-to-end, this is not a "one shot prompt", it took me a few days with Opus 5.5

Enjoy !

comments.author: GCC_GicaCamelCase
comments.body: You should add a loading bar progress beside x/17. My internet is not the best and I'm not sure if it got stuck at 15/17 or not.

replies.author: MorophonBoundless
replies.body: Yes the first download might be a bit longer (planet/moons textures are being cached) but afterwards you should be fine
